title: Hydra Host, a marketplace for developers and enterprises to procure GPUs pooled from data center operators, raised a $100M Series A led by Kindred Ventures (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: Hydra Host, a marketplace for developers and enterprises to procure GPUs pooled from data center operators, raised a $100M Series A led by Kindred Ventures — Data center infrastructure startup Hydra Host Inc. said today it has bagged $100 million in a Series A round of funding led by Kindred Ventures.
